jobs.title: IB - Fixed Income Trading, Credit Trader - Analyst/Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
The Credit Trader (Fixed Income & Currencies) is responsible for market-making in CNY corporate bonds and managing book risk across a diverse range of products, including rates bonds, interest rate swaps (IRS), and FX.This role drives franchise growth by developing new products, expanding origination and distribution channels in collaboration with Sales, and ensuring rigorous risk management.
What We Will Offer You
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
15 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Your key responsibilities:
Fixed Income Trading: Act as the dedicated Fixed Income Trader for DB China flow trading, driving revenue growth while strictly adhering to the established limit framework.
Expand Franchise: Identify and capture new market opportunities to build and scale the bank's franchise alongside internal stakeholders.
Manage Portfolio Risk: Monitor and manage trading book risk dynamically across fixed income, derivatives, and FX products.
Collaborate Across Desks: Partner with Sales and Structuring to enhance product origination and distribution capabilities.
Your skills and experience:
Market Expertise: 2–5 years of trading experience with deep fundamental and technical knowledge of the CNY fixed income market.
Risk Management: Proven understanding of portfolio risk dynamics and the impact of macroeconomic and microeconomic indicators.
Relationship Management: Demonstrated grasp of the sales-trader model, with a track record of building strong internal partnerships and external client relationships.
Core Competencies: Highly motivated, innovative, and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to operational efficiency.
Communication: Fluent professional English (both written and spoken).
How We’ll Support You
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career

jobs.title: Private Bank – Relationship Manager, VP/Director
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
Deutsche Bank’s Private Bank business is one of the largest wealth managers worldwide. We offer our clients a broad range of traditional and alternative investment solutions, as well as comprehensive advice on all aspects of Wealth Management. As a trusted partner of wealthy individuals and entrepreneurs, family offices and foundations, we create lasting value for clients. We specialize in developing bespoke solutions for our clients around the world, for instance wealth planning across successive generations and international borders, asset management with individual risk management, loans and deposits. All this is possible thanks to our global network, our many years of experience and our close collaboration with the Corporate Bank, Investment Bank and DWS. We aim to become a highly competitive global wealth manager by combining financial strength and stability with trustworthy partnership and forward-thinking in order to build sustainable and beneficial client relationships. As a growth business for Deutsche Bank, we contribute towards building a more balanced, less capital intense and stable business model for the bank.
The Relationship Manager is a primary point of contact for clients to access the entire suite of wealth management capabilities and solutions offered by Deutsche Bank Wealth Management. This is achieved by working in close partnership with the Investment Manager in the day-to-day planning and servicing for the client. The individual is responsible for acquiring new clients - which are in line with the business proposition of the bank - and assets as well as grow existing business relationships, assuring a holistic and high-standard client experience.
What we will offer you:
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Your key responsibilities:
Develop, manage and maintain overall relationship with the client, providing an holistic client experience
Be the first point of contact and the overall responsible person with regard to dealing with client complaints
Develop new business with new and existing clients, spending a great proportion of time focused on bringing in new clients and new assets (prospecting), building and sustaining long-term relationships
Work as a team with the Investment Manager (and the Institutional Wealth Partner where appropriate) to build deeper client relationships / involve in origination
Keep day-to-day responsibility for advising clients within the required regulatory framework and keeping abreast of all client-impacting initiatives from the respective market
Proactively identifying client lending / financing needs, involving lending specialists to further develop the opportunity
Perform continuous market analysis to identify potential client leads and opportunities
Act as the Accountable Client Owner with responsibility for all AML aspects of the client relationship; this includes KYC in good quality and in a timely manner (no overdues) as well as account behavior, i.e. transactions with focus on 3rd party transactions constituting transfers in and out to be in line with purpose and anticipated behavior of the account(s).
Participate in relevant client social events as well as in PR and other marketing activities
Uphold the team’s operating rhythm (e.g. regular prospect review, pipeline review, account planning, etc.), leading by example and demonstrating role-model behavior
Work in close co-operation with other coverage, product and support functions to deliver DB’s value proposition, leveraging also other DB divisions where possible
Actively support the business / growth strategy, plans and values, contributing to the achievement of a high performing team
Act within professional, legal and ethical boundaries and guidelines, observing all internal and external compliance regulations and code of ethics and conduct; flagging and managing reputational risks and conflicts issues
Your skills and experience:
Minimum 5 years of relevant relationship manager experience for VP level and at least 8 years for Director level
Solid network of clients in the target coverage market is required
Familiar with One Belt One Road and relevant national policies as a national citizen who will support the country’s development.
Fluency (written and oral) in English and Chinese language
Relevant local licenses obtained
Detail orientation on both strategy and execution
Excellent communication skills
Excellent collaboration skills
Superior investment acumen
Have a good understanding of the governing regulatory framework (e.g. RDR, MiFID II, etc.), including but not limited to applicable confidentiality / secrecy / data protection regulations and cross border rules where relevant
Professional integrity
For experienced hire, solid network of clients in the target coverage market is required
Self-starter
Willing and able to develop other staff, e.g., analysts
CFA, MBA degree or other advanced degree
About us and our teams:
Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. click here to see what we do.
Deutsche Bank & Diversity
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Corporate Bank - Senior Relationship Manager(MNC) - VP
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team
Corporate Bank is the core of our bank. It is the hub for corporate and commercial clients including a global Transaction Bank.

20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement

Your Key Responsibilities
Originate strategic dialogue and new transactions with existing and new MNC client relationships.
Coordinate with global coverage and product teams, and lead client dialogue for large, sophisticated MNC clients to deliver creative solutions.

jobs.title: TSCO - FX,MM Operations Team Lead - AVP
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team
Trade Settlement & Confirmations Operations (TSCO) provides operational support to various desks within GEM and GFFX business including Corporate Banking, covering multiple products mainly Foreign Exchange, Precious Metals, Fixed Income, Money Market and Derivatives.
Primary functions performed range from trade processing, settlements, confirmations, reconciliations and reporting. TSCO also works closely with various offshore operational teams who forms part of the integral process supporting GEM/GFFX business.
What We Will Offer You
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Your Key Responsibilities
Be responsible for the daily operation covering FX, MM product including treasury support etc. Standardize related product’s KOD/SOPs, optimize front to back collaboration; coordinate front to back workflows, coordinate with compliance, finance and IT to resolve issues efficiently; ensure full compliance with regulatory rules and internal risk framework; support derivatives margin management under UMR requirement etc.
Trade Settlement and Confirmation Management
Take leadership and be responsible for foreign exchange (FX) and money market (MM) daily processing.
Liaise and follow-up with Front Office on booking and/or settlement issue and ensure timely and accurate settlement of transactions.
Ensure daily processing are in compliant with internal control policies, procedures and standards as well as external regulatory requirements.
Close monitoring and effective management of trade confirmations to reduce outstanding aged items.
Regulatory Reporting
Prepare, compile, validate and submit regulatory reports in a timely manner.
Perform quality control checks to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness
Develop report automation and perform comprehensive periodic report review and validation
Regulators face off if needed
Process Optimization and Risk Control
Identify operational inefficiencies and propose automation/streamlining solutions.
Maintain and update operational manuals/procedures to reflect current practices
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Liaise with Front Office, Compliance, Legal, to address trade exceptions, client queries or regulatory related queries
Support Strategic projects and/or ad-hoc initiatives
Control related
Conduct control self-assessment for both processes or regulatory reports, KOD and checklist design and implementation
Where necessary, review operational workflow to stay compliant with internal policies and local regulations
Your Skills And Experience
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business or related fields degree in Finance, Business or related field
Above 10 years’ work experience in investment banking or corporate banking roles and possess relevant product and regulatory knowledge
Bilingual in both written and spoken English and Mandarin
Proficient with MS Office applications
Ability to multi-task and work in dynamic environment
Demonstrate pro-activeness, self-disciplined, self-motivated with ability to work independently and effectively under pressure
Control-focused and ability to multi-task and prioritise work in fast-paced environment
Committed and reliable with a strong sense of teamwork
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
How We’ll Support You
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career

jobs.title: Corporate Bank - Trade Finance & Lending, Sales/Originator - Director
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
Deutsche Bank’s Trade Finance and Lending (TF&L) business is a significant division within the Corporate Bank that specializes in providing comprehensive financing solutions to support corporate’s activities through a comprehensive set of products such as Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Corporate Loans, Project Finance, Natural Resource Finance and Structured Trade and Export Finance.
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional to join our Core Trade Finance and International Lending (Core TFIL) team within the TF&L business at Deutsche Bank. Core TFIL is a dedicated unit holistically responsible for identifying, developing, structuring and successfully delivering bespoke client solutions and customized products across Core TFIL areas (Documentary Trade, Working Capital, Lending). In addition, the unit has a mandate to develop new products and client solutions to drive revenue by working closely with the existing structuring teams and risk functions, corporate coverage, all 2nd-line functions and product management. The Core TFIL area is particularly important in the development and global provision of tailor-made financing solutions.
The role is responsible for developing strategy and performing business development for trade finance, supply chain financing, corporate loans, and structured debt solutions for large corporate clients.
What we will offer you:
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Key responsibilities:
Drive revenue growth, portfolio quality and client engagement for the Core Trade Finance and International Lending business. The role is responsible for developing strategy and performing business development for trade finance, supply chain financing, corporate loans / lending and structured debt solutions for large corporate clients.
Responsible for providing strategic leadership to a team of product specialists and RMs, fostering a high performance, collaborative and client centric culture.
Identify market opportunities and develop innovative product propositions aligned with client needs and business strategy.
Ensure sound risk management while partnering closely with Coverage, Risk, Operations and Product teams.
Originate, structure, and execute flow and complex trade finance and lending transactions, including working capital, supply chain finance, receivables finance, structured trade, and cross border financing solutions. Prior origination and transaction structuring experience with large cap corporate clients with headquarters in China.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to originate financing business and build senior client relationship.
Deep understanding of credit, trade finance and credit products, risk management, regulatory requirements, and Greater China Banking landscape.
Your skills and experience:
12 years or more of experience in core trade finance, lending, and structured credit solutions within an international or regional financial institution
Proven track record in originating, structuring, and executing core trade finance, lending and structured credit solutions for multinational corporations and large local corporates
Track record of leading a high performing team
Strong expertise across full suite of credit solutions, core trade finance and lending products, and extensive experience in structuring secured and unsecured lending facilities
Demonstrated ability to structure bespoke financing solutions and strong credit analytical skills
Sound understanding of transaction risk, counterparty risk and non-financial risk
Proven business development capability with an established set of corporate clients in Mainland China and Hong Kong
Experience leading negotiation on transaction structuring and documentation, with strong leadership capability
Fluent in both Mandarin and English, with the ability to conduct business negotiations and manage client relationships in both languages
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
